Studied: Parkour.description:
🏙️ You spent years free-running: railings, stairwells, walls and rooftops, first with a park club and then across the city.

🌱 Vaults, wall runs, precision jumps and rolls. You see a street as a set of routes and pick a line without slowing down.
⚠️ Wet surfaces, unfamiliar roofs and long drops punish mistakes, and a chase across a whole district exhausts you.
⚖️ Running across rooftops and private property is still trespass, and building staff and police treat it so.
🏫 It shows in how you cross ordinary spaces: hopping rails, testing ledges with a hand, landing without a sound.

📈 Grants: Parkour +15
